examples.en: Subaru is one of the smallest Japanese car makers.
examples.zh: 斯巴鲁是最小的日本汽车制造商之一。

examples.en: When launched, the Macintosh was the smallest desktop computer ever produced.
examples.zh: 麦金塔电脑在投放市场时，是当时最小的台式电脑。

examples.en: Even the smallest metallic object, whether a nail file or cigarette lighter, is immediately confiscated.
examples.zh: 即便是最小的金属物品，不论是指甲锉刀还是打火机，都会立刻被没收。
